Ayuja is also believed to be a powerful name and is often used as a name for children in the hope that they will be blessed with a long and healthy life.

historical_references.reference: Ayuja was one of the twelve Adityas or Sun Gods, sons of Surya, the Sun God, and his wife Chhaya or Sanjana. Each Aditya was believed to rule a particular hour of the day.
Ayuja was also a king of the Lunar Dynasty, also known as the Somavamshi or Ikshvaku Dynasty, in ancient India during the late Mahabharata period, around the 4th or 5th century BCE.
